name: The Guild
description: Fantasy and reality collide when a surprisingly diverse group of online video-game addicts struggle to balance the game with personal relationships.

videos.title: Season 1
videos.overview: Cyd Sherman struggles to limit her time online, where she games as her alter ego Codex, a member of the Knights of Good. After the guild realizes that Zaboo has been offline for 39 hours, he appears on Codex's doorstep.

videos.title: Season 2
videos.overview: Zaboo's mother takes revenge for losing Zaboo by having Codex evicted. Codex and Zaboo move into a new apartment, where Codex meets a new love interest.

videos.title: Season 3
videos.overview: Codex was able to recover from the disastrous party by the announcement of the new expansion pack for the game, Spires of Dragonor. The Knights of Good are first in line at GameStop until a rival guild, the Axis of Anarchy, cuts in front of them.

videos.title: Season 4
videos.overview: An unexpected and unintentional one-night stand with Fawkes causes Codex to stress over what the guild thinks of her and persuades him to cover for her in a pretend relationship.

videos.title: Season 5
videos.overview: The Knights of Good travel to MegaGameORama-Con, a three-day gaming convention. Bladezz believes that he is invited by Kevinator as a special guest, but his name is not on the invite list.

videos.title: Season 6
videos.overview: Codex begins her new job working for Floyd Petrovski at the headquarters for "The Game", only to discover that he's a thoughtless tyrant who immediately turns all the other employees against her.

videos.title: Wake Up Call
videos.overview: Cyd Sherman's online gaming addiction brings more than she bargains for...

videos.title: Zaboo'd
videos.overview: Cyd Sherman's imaginary world becomes all too real when a gnome warlock shows up on her doorstep.

videos.title: The Macro Problem
videos.overview: Codex's problem with Zaboo gets sidetracked by a crisis in The Guild.

videos.title: Cheesybeards
videos.overview: The Knights of Good finally meet face to face and...it's awkward.

videos.title: Rather Be Raiding
videos.overview: Codex tries to keep the Guild meeting on track and everything goes great! Not.

videos.title: Total Wipe
videos.overview: Codex confides in Zaboo before insisting he leaves her alone. Clara's nanny quits and both Tink and Vork are up for the job. Zaboo's mother turns up and is not happy to hear that her son is in love with Codex.

videos.title: Home Invasion
videos.overview: Zaboo's mother finally convinces him to move out out Codex's house, Tink 'looks after' Clara's kids and Bladezz posts a video of the animated characters of the guild having sex with each other.

videos.title: Tipping Point
videos.overview: Codex saves Zaboo's life and Bladezz is on the verge of ruining the game for everyone. Zaboo knows how to get Bladezz back but will only surrender the information if Codex agrees to help him get away from his over-bearing mother.

videos.title: Owning Bladezz
videos.overview: The Guild confronts Bladezz and Codex holds the trump card.

videos.title: Boss Fight
videos.overview: The Knights of Good must face their toughest enemy...Zaboo's Mom.

videos.title: Link the Loot
videos.overview: A group of online gamers interact online and in real life.

videos.title: Block'd
videos.overview: Clara blows up in-game and out; Codex lays down the law to Zaboo.

videos.title: Quest Accepted!
videos.overview: Zaboo begins his journey on the road to manhood; Codex learns more about Vork than she's ever want to know.

videos.title: Heroic Encounter
videos.overview: Codex meets her new neighbor; The guys and girls of The Guild dish in separate channels.

videos.title: Sacking Up
videos.overview: Zaboo continues his quest to become a man; Tink tries to "help" Codex.

videos.title: Blow Out!
videos.overview: The girls give Codex advice; Friction between Vork and Zaboo escalates.

videos.title: Panic Attack
videos.overview: Codex deals with yet another Guildie on her doorstep.

videos.title: Emergency
videos.overview: Vork calls a Guild meeting to deal with the server downtime.

videos.title: Grouping Up
videos.overview: The Guild splits up into guys and girls night while the game server goes down.

videos.title: Socializing Sucks
videos.overview: Bladezz takes control of Guy's night; Codex's neighbor shows up at her party.

videos.title: Collision Course
videos.overview: The guys crash girl's night; Zaboo gets a rude awakening.

videos.title: Fight!
videos.overview: Characters collide (literally).

videos.title: Expansion Time
videos.overview: The Guild waits in line for their game's expansion to come out, and deals with inter-personal tension in...dysfunctional ways.

videos.title: Anarchy!
videos.overview: A group of rival gamers cut in front of The Guild at the game store. And they aren't nice about it.

videos.title: Player Down
videos.overview: The Guild tries to cope with one man down. Or maybe two.

videos.title: Get It Back!
videos.overview: Codex enters enemy territory to get her Guildie back.

videos.title: Application'd
videos.overview: The Guild struggles to fill Tink's spot.

videos.title: Newbtastic
videos.overview: Mr. Wiggly joins the Guild...unfortunately.

videos.title: Coping and Stuff
videos.overview: The Axis of Anarchy thwarts Codex's attempt to counter their attacks with logic and reasonableness.

videos.title: +10 to Bravery
videos.overview: Codex takes desperate measures to save the Guild. She even goes outside.

videos.title: Wit's End
videos.overview: The Guild crumbles under the Axis of Anarchy's attacks.

videos.title: The Return!
videos.overview: Like a Phoenix rising from the ashes, Vork returns to rebuild the Guild. Not really that dramatic, but you get the idea.

videos.title: LAN Off
videos.overview: The Axis of Anarchy and The Knights of Good face off.

videos.title: Hero
videos.overview: It's up to Codex to save The Guild all by her lonesome. Solo. No pressure, really.

videos.title: Epic Guilt
videos.overview: Codex confesses her indiscretion with Fawkes to her guild-mates.

videos.title: Strange Allies
videos.overview: Bladezz helps Codex with her computer while the rest of the guild argue about what kind of guild hall to make.

videos.title: Supportive'd
videos.overview: Vork declared that whomever raises the most money towards the guild hall gets to decide what it looks like. Zaboo decides to try being Codex's friend.

videos.title: Moving On
videos.overview: Codex comes to terms with what happened between her and Fawkes and gets a "cheesy" job.

videos.title: Loot Envy
videos.overview: Bladezz is envious of Codex's new job. Tink and Clara team up.

videos.title: Weird Respawn
videos.overview: Zaboo's mother returns; Codex and Bladezz clash at Cheesy Beard's.

videos.title: Awkward Birthday
videos.overview: Codex is shocked when an unexpected guest shows up to Zaboo's mom's birthday dinner. Clara and Tink figure out how they'll make real money.

videos.title: Busted
videos.overview: Zaboo's mom advises Vork on how to make major in-game money. The rest of the guild finds out the truth about Codex's relationship with Fawkes.

videos.title: Pirate Paddy
videos.overview: Codex makes an Internet commercial for Cheesy Beard's starring Bladezz. Bladezz edits.

videos.title: Festival of the Sea
videos.overview: The Guild joins forces to help Codex with her job. Fawkes gets a taste of his own medicine...by Jeanette. And Vork gets more than he bargained for when he foolishly attempts to get rid of Zaboo's mom.

videos.title: Hostile Takeovers
videos.overview: Vork refuses to back out of his proposal; the rest of the guild prepare.

videos.title: Guild Hall
videos.overview: The guild attends Vork's wedding.

videos.title: Road Trip!
videos.overview: The Guildies head to the gaming convention but find the road a bit...bumpy.

videos.title: Crash Pad
videos.overview: Six people sharing one hotel room does not a happy Guild make.

videos.title: Megagame-o-ramacon!
videos.overview: The Guild members hit the floor of the gaming convention full-force.

videos.title: Ends and Begins
videos.overview: Blaadez, dressed as the Pirate Paddy Guy, opens up a "booth" where fans can pose with him.

videos.title: Focus Problems
videos.overview: Codex's neurosis is rejected by the Guild as close quarters lead to hot tempers.

videos.title: Revolving Doors
videos.overview: Vork manages Bladezz's career as Codex sets out on her own to solve the problems with their game.

videos.title: Downturn
videos.overview: The Seat-Saver's network created by Zaboo gets serious as a famous writer seeks convention help, while Vork and Bladezz meet sci-fi celebrities in the autograph area.

videos.title: Social Traumas
videos.overview: Zaboo's "Seat Savers" reach breaking point as his Master Chief henchmen confront a big star. Codex encounters Tink's secret origins while Bladezz and Vork hobnob with "the fancies" at an exclusive celebrity party.

videos.title: Invite Accepted
videos.overview: Zaboo pays back Clara's favor as Tink and Codex set out on a mission together.

videos.title: Strategy Timez
videos.overview: The crowded hotel room hosts a war summit as the Guild regroups to head off the breakup of their game.

videos.title: Costume Contest
videos.overview: The Guild, semi-somewhat incognito, infiltrate the convention costume contest to stop their game from being ruined.

videos.title: Grande Finale
videos.overview: Codex tries to save the day while having to avoid cosplay carnage and hired muscle.

videos.title: Dream Questline
videos.overview: Codex starts her dream job, but it starts off with her new boss making the employees mad at her.

videos.title: New Party Members
videos.overview: Codex has her first company meeting, Clara gets a new houseguest and Vork plans a day with his lady.

videos.title: Makeshift Solutions
videos.overview: Zaboo begins crafting his perfect partner, Clara makes a video and Codex gets an odd task and an access code.

videos.title: Raid Timez
videos.overview: The Guild crashes Codex's workplace, Vork faces the uncomfortable facts of a real life relationship.

videos.title: Strange Frenemies
videos.overview: Zaboo injects himself into the office and Codex learns more of Floyd's quirks.

videos.title: Into the Breach
videos.overview: Tink and Zaboo venture into the private test server. Codex deals with yet another Guild interference at her work. Bladezz bonds with Wiggly.

videos.title: Occupy HQ
videos.overview: Vork takes his protest to the Game HQ. Tink finds commonality with Donovan.

videos.title: Dialogue Options
videos.overview: Codex steps into the game with Tink's help. Vork's attempt at culling Madeline's favor backfires.

videos.title: The Case of the Game Leak
videos.overview: Codex tries to investigate the Game leak. Clara's vlogging has a surprising effect and Vork discovers the drawbacks of advocacy.

videos.title: Tipping Points
videos.overview: Vork’s protest picks up steam as Controller Grrl and Black Knight raise the stakes. Codex attempts to talk Floyd down and Tink uncovers some unpleasant truths.

videos.title: Raid HQ!
videos.overview: Codex and Zaboo try to leave Game HQ, but face complications as Vork's protest outside turns into a riot.

videos.title: End Game
videos.overview: Floyd and the Game team weather the riot outside Game HQ as the Guildies work together to save the day.
